title: Guardian Essential poll: Albanese’s disapproval rating hits highest level as problems mount for Labor
summary_full: Australians also turn against AI datacentres, with nearly half saying they don’t want one near their homeGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastAnthony Albanese’s approval ratings have nosedived in the latest Guardian Essential poll, with the prime minister reaching his highest level of disapproval after his net popularity plummeted 10 points in just a month.Australians have also turned strongly against AI datacentres, with nearly half of the country saying they don’t want one near their home. Women, older people and One Nation and Greens supporters are among the most likely to reject living near a datacentre. Continue reading...
